spec-create: Create a new IDD spec, ADR, or spike for durable product intent.
spec-import: Import existing durable product intent into the IDD `.specs/` structure.
spec-reorganize: Reorganize existing `.specs/` intent without changing product meaning.
spec-check-implementation: Check whether implementation behavior matches durable product intent in `.specs/`.
spec-update-from-implementation: Update specs from confirmed implementation behavior intended as product intent.
